Rachel: Quick async standup — yesterday: landed the kernel patch to skip the empty-op in the microbatcher and ran a KV warmup smoke. Hit flaky p95 noise when slot reclamation kicks in (seen on canary). Blocker: can't reproduce consistently on my laptop. Today: pushing a small gating fix for slot reclamation and opening a PR for the bench harness. Need a reviewer for the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482 (please ping if you're free).
Alex: I can take the PR review tonight :eyes:. Do we have the exact bench command and the raw logs for the p95 spike so I can try to repro on the dev rig?
Liam: bench command I used locally (copyable):
```
./bench/run --model redwood-lite --seq 512 --clients 64 --batcher=continuous --kv-prefetch=true --warmup 120 --duration 600 
```
Logs: the spike shows a gap exactly when slot-reclaim hits and we rebind KV cache (snippet below).
```
[00:34:21] slot_reclaim: evicting 2 slots
[00:34:21] kv_bind: tearing down binding for slot 42
[00:34:22] request: queued (n=127)
[00:34:22] p95: 218ms
```
Liam: local bench summary from that run: p50 17ms, p95 218ms, p99 467ms, tokens/s 1.05k. The spike cluster aligns with reclamation windows.
bench-bot: automated run 6790012348 finished (canary harness). Summary: p95 jitter increased by +40ms vs baseline, repro trace id=canary-6790012348. CSV uploaded to https://bench.internal/runs/6790012348.csv :warning:
Maria: quick logistics — can we move tomorrow's rollout sync to 10:30am instead of 10? fewer conflicts on infra side. Also tagging on-call for canary window: @Alex please coordinate the rollback window if needed.
Alex: Ack, will coordinate with on-call and try the PR repro tonight. If I can repro, I'll push a debug build to the canary cluster. :shipit:
Rachel: Thanks all — I'll post the PR link in the canary channel once CI passes and add an integration test that asserts no p95 spike on small-scale slot churn. Ping me if you find a deterministic repro.
